'''January 2001 Huntsville tournament (6 January)''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Huntsville, AL on 6 January 2001. It is known from Tom Culpepper's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1600">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-01-07-how-to-be-a-scrub-huntsville-al-1-6-00d1600/ how-to-be-a-scrub-huntsville-al-1-6-00], DeckTech (Tom "Gand" Culpepper, 7 January 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-01-07-how-to-be-a-scrub-huntsville-al-1-6-00d1600/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 6 January 2001
* '''Site:''' Huntsville, AL
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Jabba's Palace Sealed Deck]]
